content.comment_body: Hello, Last year I purchased [product_name] V8.0 and now wish to upgrade to the newer version, V8.1. The 'Update Center' locates the V8.1 Service Pack but does not download it. What could be the reason? At the moment I need to transfer some programs to a [product_name] [article_no]. Although the connection establishes successfully, the program does not transfer. --- Split from 'Getting Started with Version 8'.
Hello [user_name], You can get the latest version, V8.1.1 (V8.1 SP1), from [url]: Demo software, upgrades/updates, drivers. After downloading, run the 'setup.exe' file as administrator.
A new question published by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Need [product_name] 8.1 on USB'. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble updating [product_name] from V8.0 to V8.1; the update is detected but not downloading via the Update Center. Additionally, there are issues transferring programs to [product_name] hardware, even though the connection is established, suggesting possible difficulties with the software or communication process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward update experience for [product_name] and an easy program transfer to their [product_name] hardware after updating.
